transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi Dr. Smith. I'm Santiago. I guess I'm here because... well, I've been having this issue with food late at night. 

What really worries me is that once I start picking at things, I just can't seem to stop. I'll actually tell myself, "That's enough, Santiago," but my hand just keeps going back for more. It's honestly like I don't get to make the decision anymore. I just wanted to see if I could get some help with that.
During these episodes, would you say that you are eating an amount of food that most other people would consider unusually large?

Yeah, I would say it is. I mean... on some nights after work, I can go through several tamales, a big bowl of pozole, tortillas, and just whatever rice or beans are left in the fridge. And I do it all while just standing there in the kitchen, almost like I'm just cleaning up the leftovers. So, yeah, it's definitely a lot of food.
When you are eating these large amounts of food, do you feel like you are unable to stop or unable to control how much you are eating?

Yeah, that's exactly what I meant earlier. Like I was saying, I'll literally be telling myself, "That's enough," but my hand just keeps reaching for more food anyway. It really does feel like I don't have a choice in the matter... like my brain knows I should stop, but I just can't make myself do it. So, yes, I definitely feel like I can't control it once I start.
How do you typically feel about yourself or your behavior after these episodes of eating?

Honestly, I feel pretty terrible about it afterwards. Usually, right when I finish, I just feel really guilty and disgusted with myself. I'll look at all the empty wrappers or the empty containers and just think, "Why did I do that again?" It's embarrassing, even though no one else is around to see it. It just makes me feel really down on myself.
After these episodes of eating, do you ever do anything to try to compensate for the food, such as making yourself vomit, using laxatives, or exercising excessively?

No, I don't do any of that. I just... sit there with it, I guess. I've never tried to make myself throw up or taken anything like that. And I definitely don't exercise to work it off. I just feel bad about it and go to bed.
